DIRECT SUPPORT AND GENERAL SUPPORT MAINTENANCE REPAIR PARTS AND SPECIAL TOOLS LIST ENGINE DIESEL: 8 CYLINDER, NATURALLY ASPIRATED, DETUNED, 6.5 LITER ENGINE DIESEL: 8 CYLINDER, NATURALLY ASPIRATED, 6.2 AND 6.5 LITER ENGINE DIESEL: 8 CYLINDER, TURBOCHARGED, 6.5 LITER INTRODUCTION SCOPE This Repair Parts and Special Tools List (RPSTL) lists and authorizes spares and repair parts; special tools; Test, Measurement, and Diagnostic Equipment (TMDE); and other special support equipment required for performance of direct support and general support maintenance of the 6.2 and 6.5 liter V-8 diesel engines. It authorizes the requisitioning, issue, and disposition of spares, repair parts, and special tools as indicated by the Source, Maintenance, and Recoverability (SMR) codes. GENERAL In addition to the Introduction Work Package, this Repair Parts and Special Tools List is divided into the following work packages:

Repair Parts List Work Packages. Work packages containing lists of spares and repair parts authorized for use in the performance of maintenance. The list also includes parts which must be removed for replacement of the authorized parts. Parts lists are composed of functional groups in ascending alpha- numeric sequence, with the parts in each group listed in ascending figure and item number sequence. Bulk materials are listed in item name sequence. Repair parts kits are listed separately in their own functional group within section II. Repair parts for reparable special tools are also listed in this section. Items listed are shown on the associated illustration(s)/figure(s).

Special Tools List Work Packages. Work packages containing lists of special tools, special TMDE, and other special support equipment authorized by this RPSTL (as indicated by Basis of Issue (BOI) information in DESCRIPTION AND USABLE ON CODE column) for the performance of maintenance.

Cross-Reference Indexes Work Packages. There are two cross-reference indexes work packages in this RPSTL: The National Stock Number (NSN) Index work package and the Part Number (P/N) Index work package. The National Stock Number Index work package refers you to the figure and item number appearance. The Part Number Index work package list all part numbers in alphanumeric sequence and refers you to the figure and item number appearance. HOW TO LOCATE REPAIR PARTS When National Stock Number or Part Number is Not Known. (1) First. Using the table of contents, determine the assembly group or subassembly group to which the item belongs. This is necessary since figures are prepared for assembly groups and subassembly groups, and listings are divided into the same groups.

(2) Second. Find the figure covering the assembly group or subassembly group to which the item belongs. (3) Third. Identify the item on the figure and use the Figure and Item Number Index to find the NSN. When National Stock Number or Part Number is Known. (1) First. Using the Index of National Stock Numbers and Part Numbers, find the pertinent National Stock Number or Part Number. The NSN index is in National Item Identification Number (NIIN) sequence (see 4.a.(1)). The part numbers in the Part Number index are listed in ascending alphanumeric sequence (see 4.b.). Both indexes cross-reference you to the illustration figure and item number of the item you are looking for. (2) Second. After finding the figure and item number, verify that the item is the one you’re looking for, then locate the item number in the repair parts list for the figure. HOW TO IDENTIFY ENGINE MODELS. The 1990 and above engines have some new and revised parts which are not interchangeable with parts for previous model engines. Make sure you know which engine model you have before ordering replacement parts. The 1990 engine is identified by a decal which is adhered to the left rocker arm cover. The 6.5L engine is identified by serial number bar code decal.

p015-img01.alt: Engine emissions information decal for a 1990 6.2 liter engine, beside a drawing showing where the decal sits on the left rocker arm cover.

p015-img02.caption: 6.5 LITER
p015-img02.alt: Line drawing of the 6.5 liter engine left rocker arm cover area showing where the serial number bar code decal is located.

p016-img01.caption: Figure 1. Engine and Container Assembly
p016-img01.alt: Exploded view of a diesel engine between its shipping container cover and base frame, with washers, lock washers and bolts that mount it.

p021-img01.caption: Figure 2. Engine Block Assembly and Cylinder Head (Sheet 1 of 2)
p021-img01.alt: Exploded view of the engine block with its main bearing caps, one cylinder head above and one to the left, head gasket, plugs, bolts and a cylinder sleeve.

p022-img01.caption: Figure 2. Engine Block Assembly and Cylinder Head (Sheet 2 of 2).
p022-img01.alt: View of the front of the engine block with a metal tube and its mounting screw drawn above the timing cover area.

p028-img01.caption: Figure 3. Crankshaft, Damper, Bearings, and Pulley
p028-img01.alt: Exploded view of a crankshaft with main bearing halves, rear seal, key, vibration damper, bolt and two drive pulleys.

p032-img01.caption: Figure 4. Flywheel.
p032-img01.alt: Rear view of the engine block with the flywheel pulled off the crankshaft flange and one mounting bolt shown.

p034-img01.caption: Figure 5. Piston Assembly, Rod Assembly, and Ring Set
p034-img01.alt: Exploded view of a piston with rings, piston pin and retaining rings, connecting rod, rod cap, bolt, nut and bearing halves.

p036-img01.caption: Figure 6. Valves, Guides, and Rocker Arm Assemblies
p036-img01.alt: Exploded view of rocker arms, rocker shaft, intake and exhaust valves with springs and seals, a push rod, tappet and valve lifter plate and clamp.

p040-img01.caption: Figure 7. Camshaft, Timing Chain, and Related Parts
p040-img01.alt: Exploded view of the camshaft with its five bearings, timing gears, sprockets and timing chain, thrust plate, key and screws, drawn over a dashed timing cover.

p042-img01.caption: Figure 8. Crankcase Cover Assembly and Rocker Cover
p042-img01.alt: Exploded view of a rocker cover with gasket, the timing gear cover with baffle, seal, timing indicator and hardware, and the cover plate.

p044-img01.caption: Figure 9. Engine Oil Pan, Pump, and Filler Tube
p044-img01.alt: Exploded view of the engine oil pan with gaskets and drain plug, oil pump with screen and relief valve, drive shaft, and the oil filler neck and cap.

p048-img01.caption: Figure 10. Oil Filter, Adapter, and Oil Line Fittings
p048-img01.alt: Exploded view of the oil filter, filter mount bracket, adapters and fittings on the side of the engine.

p050-img01.caption: Figure 11. Air Intake Manifold (6.2L and 6.5L Naturally Aspirated and 6.5L Detuned)
p050-img01.alt: Exploded view of an air intake manifold with washers, studs, bolts, gasket and a fitting.

p052-img01.caption: Figure 12. Air Intake Manifolds (6.5L Turbo)
p052-img01.alt: Exploded view of the turbo engine air intake manifold pieces, gaskets, stud and bolt.

p054-img01.caption: Figure 13. Exhaust Manifolds (6.2L and 6.5L Naturally Aspirated and 6.5L Detuned)
p054-img01.alt: Two exploded views of the right and left exhaust manifolds with gaskets, washers and fasteners.

p056-img01.caption: Figure 14. Exhaust Manifolds (6.5L Turbo)
p056-img01.alt: Two views showing the left and right turbo exhaust manifolds being bolted to the cylinder heads, with FRONT arrows.

p058-img01.caption: Figure 15. Fuel Injector Nozzle and Gasket.
p058-img01.alt: Fuel injector nozzle assembly with its sealing gasket below.

p060-img01.caption: Figure 16. Fuel Pump and Mounting Hardware
p060-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel pump with gaskets, mounting plate, pin and two bolts.

p062-img01.caption: Figure 17. Fuel Injection Pump and Fuel Filter Lines (6.2L and 6.5L Naturally Aspirated and 6.5L Detuned).
p062-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel injection pump, gasket, fuel filter lines, hoses, clamps and nuts.

p066-img01.caption: Figure 18. Fuel Injection Pump and Fuel Filter Lines (6.5L Turbo)
p066-img01.alt: Exploded view of the turbo engine fuel injection pump, filter lines, hoses, clamps and fasteners.

p068-img01.caption: Figure 19. Fuel Injection Supply and Return Lines
p068-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel injection supply and return lines, clamps, grommets, straps and mounting bracket on the engine.

p074-img01.caption: Figure 20. Fuel Injection Pump Cover Assembly, Governor Linkage, and Related Parts
p074-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel injection pump cover, solenoids, terminals, governor linkage, springs and washers above the pump housing.

p078-img01.caption: Figure 21. Fuel Injection Pump Throttle Shaft, Regulator, Transfer Pump, and Related Parts
p078-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel injection pump throttle shaft, regulator, transfer pump parts, springs, pistons and plugs around the pump housing.

p084-img01.caption: Figure 22. Fuel Injection Pump Housing, Head and Rotor, Drive Shaft, and Related Parts
p084-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fuel injection pump housing, head and rotor, drive shaft, cam ring, weights and related small parts.

p090-img01.caption: Figure 23. Turbocharger Assembly
p090-img01.alt: Exploded view of the turbocharger with its mounting bolt, O-ring, exhaust pipes, and clamps.

p092-img01.caption: Figure 24. Glow Plug.
p092-img01.alt: Single glow plug shown from the side with its terminal at the top.

p094-img01.caption: Figure 25. Accelerator Cable Bracket and Idle Spring.
p094-img01.alt: Exploded view of the accelerator cable bracket, bolt and idle spring beside the fuel injection pump.

p096-img01.caption: Figure 26. Thermostat, Water Crossover, and Attaching Hardware
p096-img01.alt: Exploded view of the thermostat, water outlet housings, crossover pipe, gaskets, hose and fittings.

p100-img01.caption: Figure 27. Water Pump and Attaching Hardware.
p100-img01.alt: Exploded view of the water pump with gasket, fittings, studs and cap screws.

p102-img01.caption: Figure 28. Fan Drive and Pulley
p102-img01.alt: Exploded view of the fan clutch, fan drive parts and pulleys.

p104-img01.caption: Figure 29. Sending Units (6.2L and 6.5L Naturally Aspirated)
p104-img01.alt: Sending units and switches shown beside and installed on the top of a V8 diesel engine.

p108-img01.caption: Figure 30. Sending Units (6.5L Turbo)
p108-img01.alt: Sending units, hose and bracket for the turbocharged 6.5 liter engine, shown with a dashed engine outline.

p110-img01.caption: Figure 31. Fan Cut-Off Switch, Throttle Position Sensor, and Engine Speed Sensor
p110-img01.alt: Exploded views of the fan cut-off switch, throttle position sensor and engine speed sensor with brackets and hardware.

p112-img01.caption: Figure 32. Modulator Rod Assembly and Bracket (6.2L and 6.5L Detuned).
p112-img01.alt: Modulator rod and electrical bracket for Basic and A1 vehicles, with the rod running to the engine.

p114-img01.caption: Figure 33. Power Steering Pump Support Bracket (6.2L and 6.5L Detuned).
p114-img01.alt: Power steering pump support bracket with two nuts, drawn on a dashed engine outline.

p116-img01.caption: Figure 34. Data Plates.
p116-img01.alt: Data plate and tapping screw mounted at the injection pump, drawn on a dashed engine outline.

p122-img01.caption: Figure 35. Special Tools
p122-img01.alt: Four special tools: seal installer, engine lifting sling, seal inserter and engine maintenance stand.

p124-img01.caption: Figure 36. Special Tools
p124-img01.alt: Special tool set: sockets, camshaft bearing puller parts, screwdriver bits and crowfoot attachments.

p126-img01.caption: Figure 37. Special Tools
p126-img01.alt: Injection pump special tools: holder fixture and plate, bushing installer kit, dial indicator, wrenches and inserters.

p128-img01.caption: Figure 38. Special Tools.
p128-img01.alt: Five injection pump special gages: linkage gap tool, indicator, throttle gage, circular protractor and air comparator.
